Each one transcribed the same clip, edited a captioned cut from its transcript, and reported how well its timestamps matched the audio. Now brokers are offering live companies six to seven figures for Slack DMs and emails, then reselling them to AI labs. If your old messages are worth millions, should you get a cut?
